stasisturret.def: A throwable turret made from your charged grenade (Bleak Watcher) that fires seeking, slowing projectiles at nearby enemies. It counts as a grenade ability.
stasisturret.q: Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.

diamondlance.def: A single-use Stasis lance (Titan aspect) that appears after Stasis or shatter kills; throw it or slam it to freeze enemies and shatter crystals.
diamondlance.q: Shatter or defeat targets with [Stasis] Stasis abilities or weapons to create a Stasis lance.

handling.def: A temporary boost to how fast your weapons ready, stow and aim.
handling.q: Increases weapon handling and health after freezing a target with [Stasis] Stasis.

reload.def: Instantly reloads your weapons' magazines from reserves.
reload.q: Damaging targets with a [Stasis] Stasis melee reloads your weapons

howlcrystal.def: The Stasis crystals spawned by Howl of the Storm's sliding uppercut. Unlike other Stasis crystals, their damage counts as powered melee damage.
howlcrystal.q: Howl's Crystal Damage counts as Powered Stasis Melee Damage
